inputs.original_text:
Open your eyes, people. They want you to believe this is just some routine administrative update, but Senate Bill 175 is part of a much bigger, coordinated game being played by the hidden elites pulling the strings in the shadows. South Dakota Governor Larry Rhoden signed this bill on Thursday, supposedly to make new registered voters prove that they are United States citizens in order to cast a ballot in state elections. 

Don't buy the official cover story that it only appl[y] to state elections and only impacts new registrants. That’s just a smokescreen designed to hide their true, calculated motives. When the establishment pushes a narrative this hard through their controlled press releases, you know the exact opposite is really going on behind closed doors. They are engineering the system to tighten their grip and manipulate who gets to participate, all while pretending it's a minor restriction. Every single thing they announce is a calculated distraction from their ultimate agenda.

Do not fall for their official cover story that it only applies to state elections and only impacts new registrants. That is a smokescreen designed to hide their true, calculated motives. The hidden elites pulling the strings in the shadows are engineering the system to tighten their grip and manipulate who gets to participate, using this narrative as a calculated distraction from their ultimate agenda.
